scenes.title: Two repairs. Same total.
scenes.narration: Two patches. Same total. One is wrong.

scenes.title: Which repair can Nora trust?
scenes.narration: Meet Nora, a quantum research software engineer. Her job is to accept a repair without changing what the evidence supports.

scenes.title: A decision, not a dashboard.
scenes.narration: In the real interface, I choose a sample and run its local review. The valid repair matches all four pairs. Now I select the deliberately wrong control. Its total is still two point six zero, but the verifier rejects it.

scenes.title: The number matches. The evidence does not.
scenes.narration: The individual correlations tell a different story. A matching total hides conflicting pair values. LabRepair shows the difference that changes the decision. These local samples use synthetic data.

scenes.title: A real model. A deliberately bounded job.
scenes.narration: For the recorded model step, NVIDIA Nemotron ran on Nebius Token Factory. Our prompt supplied the channel convention. The model translated it into typed parameters; it did not discover the correction. A deterministic adapter built the patch, keeping the counts and tests protected.

scenes.title: Then test the repair against protected evidence.
scenes.narration: A real Nebius Sandbox operation tested three source variants. Baseline: two of four checks. Model repair: four of four. Wrong-pair control: three of four, rejected. The recorded operation took one point two seven three seconds, with guest networking disabled.

scenes.title: The code passed. The claim did not.
scenes.narration: The repair passes at two point six zero. The original three point four zero claim remains not reproduced. Those are separate decisions.

scenes.title: Missing evidence changes the next step.
scenes.narration: For incomplete evidence, the interface asks for review. It does not invent the missing value. This is a local uncertainty control, not another cloud execution.

scenes.title: Leave a decision someone else can inspect.
scenes.narration: Nora records a hold against the reviewed source. The evidence receipt preserves the checks and her intent. Recording intent launches no new job.

scenes.title: Repair the analysis. Preserve the evidence.
scenes.narration: LabRepair. Repair the analysis. Preserve the evidence. A passing repair is not a reproduced result.
